Ki Khua Ki Keiew U Hynniew Trap kat kum ka khana tynrai, lyngba ki parom Barim Bajah, ngi tip ba U Trai Nongthaw Nongbuh u la ai ha ki Longshwa Manshwa ki 5Ji ki Kong kulong kumah jong ngi ia kane ka RI U SOHPET BNfcNG. La pyrshang mynta ban lum shi jaka ia ki jmgtip bad dang ioh kynshew dang tang shiphew lynnong. Ka jait bynriew Hyniiiew Trep ka long kaba khraw, kaba la law bha ha ka pyrkhat pyrdain bad ki ju long ki ’riew shlur. Ki don la ka Geography bad ka History jong ki ka long kaba la myndai bah. Kumta lah ban lum thup shaphang jong ki wat da ki spah bad hajar lynnong sla, lada baroh baroh ngi iasei la u lyngka. Id shniaht u 'nembah ban tih la ki par jingtip shaphang la ka ri bad ka jait bynriew. Ngi don ka daw ban sngew sarong haba ngi kyrtiang dien la ka mynnor bad ngin laid heh mynsiem ban ialam ia la ki pateng ban dang wan sha ka hok ka jingshisha.

Ngim don kam iano iano ba kin pynbatai lem shaphang ka thymmei jong ngi — hynrei dei ma ngi ki ban pynshai ia ki nongwei nongar u dkhar u lyngkien, lada ki kwah tip shaphang Ki Khan Ki Keiew U Hynniew Trep. Ha ka liang ki kur ki jait, la pyrshang ban lum ban lang katba lah ban tip. Napdeng ki jait ba la kyntiew bad pyni ha ka lynnong “Ki kur ki jait” la shem hadien ba don ki jait ba dang jah, wat la ki iadon jait don kur mynta. Kumta kum ka jingiathuh sdang, ki jait Lyngdoh Thaiang ki jait Syiem Nongkhap bad jait Syiem Thaiang ki dei ki jait Hynniew Trep paka wat la kim shym don ha katei ka lynnong. Kyrmen yn lah ban pynjanai la kane ka jingpyrshang da ka jinglasnoh kti lang baroh ha ki por ban dang wan . La sngew pyrto ia ki Nongthoh kot harum etc, kiba la ai jingshai shaphang la ka jong ka ri bad kiba iarap ia nga shi katdei : — (1) Parad Medro Singh Diengdoh (Ka Thymmei ki Laloo ). (2) Ki Dkhot Ka Khasi National Dorbar (Ki Proceedings). (3) Bah L.G. Shullai (Ki Hima Khasi etc.) (4) Bah S. Quotient Sumer (U Kiang Nangbah ). (5) Ki Nongkit kam ka Khasi Students’ Association (Na ka bynta K.S.A. Magazine, 1965). (6) Ka Sorkar Meghalaya (na ka bynta ka jingshah sngewbha ban thied jem dor ia ka kot sada). (7) Ki Nongthoh bad Nongpyniaid jong ka Syngkhong Jingtip (na ka bynta ka Syngkhong Jingtip Magazine Vol. No 4 dated ka snem 1939). Khadduh, ngan da sngew myntoi shibun eh lada ioh ki jingpyni jingmut ha kano kano ka rukom halor kane ka kot. Dated, Shillong Risaw 2. Khublei, V Spite* Kharakor KI KHUN KI KSIEW U HYNftlEW TREP LYNNONG— I KI R1TI KI DUSTUR U HYNfttEW TREP Ki khun ki ksiew u Hynniew Trep Hynniew Skum ki long ka jail bynriew kaba kyrpang kaba don la ka nongrim tynrai lajong. La pynneh i'a kine ki nongrim tynrai lyngba ki riti ki dustur kiba long ki rukom im ka jait bynriew jong ngi naduh ki sngi barim. Ka jait bynriew kaba shai ha kano kano ka bynta jong ka pyrthei, ka don la u jong u diengkot ban thew i'a ka long rynleng ka jait bynriew da ka dustur jong ka. Bunsien la ju lap ba ka jait bynriew kaba duk ba ka liang ka riti dustur bad nongrim tynrai (culture) ka shah nguid noh ha kiwei pat. Ngi ki longdien Hynniew Trep ngi donbok shi katdei eh ba ki longshwa ki la buh la ka riti ka dustur kaba skhem ha ki longdien ban bud bad pynneh. U khun bynriew shisnieh pyrthei u iasyr'iiem dur i'a ka ’per syniew ba bun ki rong. Lada uwei u jait syntiew u duh noh, ka ji ngi tynnad jong ka kper ka nang blad bad nang lip rong. U Trai Nongthaw, ngi ngeit u don la ka jingthmu haba u buh byariew katne ha la ki rukom ba u la thmu Kumta ka long ka kamram jong ngi ki longdien ban pynneh i'a ki riti ki dustur tynrai ban skhem ka jait bynriew Hynniew Trep Hynniew Skum. Ka Riti dustur ka iai neh da ki rukom leh bad jingbuddien jong ka ia ka nongrim jong ka ri bad ka jait bynriew. Lah ban phiah la ka riti bad dustur ha ki bun bynta jong ka jingim kaba ka jait bynriew jong ngi ka ju bat naduh ki sngi barim ba jah. To ngin shim mynta tang shaphang ka Ri U Hynniew Trep, ki briew, ka rukom pyn'iaid khyndew. ka rukom kren ha ka ktien ka thylliej, ka synshar khadar, ka niam bad kiwei. Kine ki long ki jinglongtynrai jong ka kaba ki longshwa ki la saiiidur bad ki khlem i'apan kylliang ne shah hikai ha kiwei pat. Haba shu ong lyngkot k.t ktien riti dustur ka mut ka jingstad kyrpang jong ka jait bynriew, kaba pyni la ka sap nylla jong ha bapaw shabar ha khmat ka pvrthei. 2 KJ KHUN KI KSIEW U HYNNIEW TRE P Ka Ri U Hynniew Trep Bad Ki Briew Ilaba kren shaphang kane ka ri, ki tyinmen ki i'aiap shaphang u Sohpetbncng, ka Diensiei, u Lum Shyllong, u mawlong ’lei Mawpeiri, ka Syntu Ksiar, ka "jaw Dai ja, u Lum Meikha bad ka pyntha rupa tylli jong ka, . U Blci u la ai ha ngi ia kane ka ri ban shong ban sah ban rep ban riang. Ha ka bang ki briew, ngi ngeit ba ngi hiar pateng na u Hvnniew Trcp Hynniew skum hyndai, uba long kawei ka kynhun na kita ki Khadhynriew Trcp Khadhynrievv Skum mynnor. Ka jingkylli ha kane ka jak ka long ba ngim da khuslai eh ban lip nangno ngi wan, hynrei shano kita kiba jah ki lalcR haduh kine ki sngi.

U Sajar Nangli bad la ka kynhun u la phct da ki spah snem mynshwa, bad mynta don kiba la jah noh sha kiwei ki jylla bad kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei. Tip ki dang leh Hynniew Trep nc em ha i'ieng ha sem kum ha ka kren ka khana haduh ka riam ka beit ki kynthei ne ngam jyllop ha ki palong ba kynoi jungka por? Ka Ktien Khasi La ju i'aiap ba ka ktien Khasi ha la ka kren Sohra, Nongkrem, Jwai, Arnwi ter ter ka long kum ka devvlynnong ha kane ka thain. Ngim don jingi'adei ei ei rub ha ka ktien ka thylliej bad ki marjan jongngi. Hynrei ha kajuh ka por la suba bad tharai pat ba ka don ka jingiasyriiem ne iakhong bad ki jait bynriew sha jngai bah ha Asia shathie mihngi. Kawei na ki daw ka jingkha ia ka jylla Meghalaya ha ka snem 1970 bad 1972 ka long ka ktien kren Sorkar ha Assam. Ka ktien Khasi ka la nang roi mynta ha ka thoh kot thoh sla bad ngi angnud kan ioh ia ka kyrdan (national status) kumba ioh lcm kiwei ki jait ktien ha Ri India kloi katba lah. Ka Rukom PyniaJd Khyndew Ha ka liang ka khyndew ka shyiap ki Barim ki la buh ia ka dustur pyniaid khyndew kaba beit bad ryntih. Haba shu kren kyllum don tang lai tylli ki jait khyndew ha ka ri — ka ’Ri kymi, ka ‘Ri kur bad ka ’Ri Raid. Katba ka rukom pyrkhat tynrai ka dang khara ym ju don satia ka jinglusha ban pynsniew dur Ia ka rukom pyniaid khyndew. Ngi tip ba ka bri kvnti ka long jong uwei ne kawei ka briew shimet. Ki lah ban leh katba ki sngewbit ia ka khyndew jong ki. Nangta ka bri kur ka long ka jong ka jait ka khong ba lamih na kajuh ka kpoh ka jait. Ki ju thung ia u Rangbah kur ban pyniaid na ka bvnta ka kur. Khadduh, ka bri raid ka dei ka jong u khun u hajar bym don khyndew. Kf RITr KI DUSTUR U HYNftlEW TREP 3 Kine ki lah ban bat ia ka khyndew katba ki dang trei. Hynrei !ada kim trei shuh, ka phai biang sha ka raid. Kane ka riti ka la jan duh mynia bad bunsien ki‘ri raid ki kvlla ’ri kynti noh da kafca pynduh hok ia ki khun ka raid. Wat u mawbri ruh u ju k)nriah jaka ha kine ki por. Donkam ka jingphira ha kanc ka Jiang. Ka Riti Synshar Shaphang ka synshar khadar, u Hyniiiew Trep u long uba la san bha ha ka dohnud tip briew bad ka khlieh sain hima. U i'eug skhem bad seng nongrim ha ka synshar paidbah bad u buh ia ka kur ha khmat bad ki dkhot jong ka hadien. U ngeit ha ka jing'iaryngkat kyrdan Ki tral kur ha ka Raid bad lyngba ki Raid la pynlong ia ki Hima. Ha kanc ka rukom sa mih ki Hima ba phcr ha ka ri. La iathuh ruh ba ka long kaba shitom ban ioh ka kur ne u briew uba treh ban shimti ia ka kam Kangbah Hima, bad kim ju buh pat ne kyntiew ia uno uno u Rangbah Raid ban shimti ia ka kam synshar ha ka hima. Bunsien ki wad ia ka kur ba kyrpang kaba lah ban pyniasyriiem ka jinglong ha ka hima baroh kawei. ia u Rangbah kur jong kata ka jait ba iasyriiem ki khot If Syiem u Kmie. Ha kane ka rukom sa mih ki briew kiba hap ban shimti ia ka kam Syiem ban neh ka hima. Nangfa kam ju don ka jingialeh ne iaknieh ban ioh long syiem ne long ei ei ha ka kam synshar khadar hapoh ka Hima. Ki kur kynthei wat la kim don bynta ha ka Synshar Hima, Raid ne Shnong, hynrei ki sei pat ia ki Rang Korbar-ri ban shimti ia ka kam ban long bakbraw ha ka Hima kaba ki don hok. Ka Shad Ka Kmen Ka jait bynricw Hyniiiew Trep ka long kaba riewspah ha ka liang ka shad ka kmen, ka Yasiat thong bad ka rwai ka siaw. Nangta k a ju don ka shad shnong ne shad Hima ha kaba ki nongshad kynthei bad shynrang ki da deng da kup haba ki mih ha Lympung shad. Ki sei la ki mar ksiar mar rupa ban pyni donburom ha khmat u khmih kai u khmih laid. Tang ki ’thei sotti kiba lah ban shim bynta ha ki kynja Shad Suk Mynsicm bad kiwei de ki rukom shad, Ki shynrang ki lah ban shad khlem don jingadong ei ei ruh. 4 KI KHUN KI KSIEW U HYNftlEW TREP Ka Rukom Hiar Pateng Ha Ka Jingdon Jf'ngem .Shaphang ka hiar pateng u Hynniew Trcp um ju pyrkhat ia ka shimet hynrei khamtam ia ka iieng.

Kumta u long u riewtrei lang (Socialist) naduh na la iieng nyngkong. Ka iieng kmie ka long ka lieng kaba u niewkor eh* Hangta u i'alum bad pyrkhat ia ka jingbit ka lieng bad ki pyrsa para. Ka iieng ruh kumjuh ka lum ia u kur ne para ba don ha ka shitom shipa. Lait noh na ka para khadduh baroh ki hynmen kynthei bad ki shynrang kiba la don biiew ki long ki khun mih iieng suda. Ka para khadduh ka ri bad sumar ia ka lieng kmie, Kam lah ban rai marwei ia ka kam jong ka iieng khlem ka Dorbar iieng ha kaba ki hymmen bad ki kni ki pyniaid. Ki kmie ki kpa ba kham ioh kham kot ki pynkam i'a ka spah ka phew nongkynti ha ki khun ki kti shynrang ne kynthei kat ba ki sngewbit. Ki Rangbah Hynniew Trep ki long kiba khraw mynsiem bad ki ai hok ia ki kynthei, kaba niar eh kiwei ki shynrang ha ka pyrthei kin leh sbun mynsiem ia ki kynihei. Ka Niam Ka rukom ngeit ni im jong u Hynniew Trep ka long beit tang ha u Blei Trai Nongthaw. U shim ia ka niam kum ka kam iieng ne ka kam kur ha kaba ka niam ka Jong ka dustur ban leh hok bad kirn ju khmih ban ioh jingmyntoi ei ei hadien ka jingiap, Ju ngeit ba ka mynsiem ka leit phai sha Dwar u Blei bad sa mih ka rukom kren kaba ki ju ong ia ki ba lap “Leit bam kwai ha Dwar U Blei”. ka Niam Khasi ne niam tynrai ka ong ba ia u briew la kha hok sha pyrthei bud kim ngeit ba ia ki khyllung la kha pap ia ki. Hateng hateng ju ”iynlong ia ka Niam Hima, ka Niam Raid ne ka Niam Shnong ha ki jaka ba kyrpang kum ki ’Law Lyngdoh, ’Law kyntang ne ’Law Adong. Kine ki khyndew ki long ki bvnta jong ka Niam Khasi. Kim ju pynkylla ni im ia kiwei ki jait bynriew sha ka Niam Khasi, hynrei kim pyrshah pat ia ki kynthei dkhar ne kynthei nongwei ban long Niam Khasi lada ki shong kha ia ki shynrang Hynniew Trep. Ka Pateng Ki Longdien U Hynniew Trep u don ka thong mynta — lada ngi mut hok ne em ban pynneh ia ki Riti Dustur u Ni u Kong ? Ngi tip mynta, ka don ka jingpisa mynsiem kaba jur ha ki khun ka ri kumno ban pynneh ia ka sap ki long shuwa, la ha teng ha teng ka d^n ka jing’iatyngkhuh hapdeng ka mon ba laitluid bad ka jingshahteh kynjri, ka jingsat KI RITI KI DUSTUR U HYNfilEW TREP 5 mynsiem bad ka jingieid, hapdeng ka im ka lap ka jaitbynriew hi. Ka pyrthci Hynniew Trep ka donkam ia ka jing’ialeh ban tur pyrshah ia ki ’cr langthari na mihngi sepngi bad pyndem la ka mon ym sha ka liang kaba i khlain jop hynrei ban i'aid sha ka lynti kaba dei. Da kumta kein ka dustur riti u Hynniew Trep kan 'iai iphuh ha ki jingtyllun ka por. U Myllung Soso Tham haba u rwai shaphang ka Atom Ksiar ha ka kot ieid ri “Ki Sngi Bmm U Hynniew Trep” u ong shaphang ka Riii jong ngi kumne : “Shi khrum ka bneng — u paid byllien, Shisnieh Pyrthei— kawei ka ktien: Pyilun ka Ri— kajuh ka Niam: Ban paw ha rong— shi rong ka Riam: Hangno ha Pyrthei don Riti, Ba kum ka jcng ka Ri jong ngi.” LYNNONG-II KI KUR KI JAIT Ki Khun ki ksiew u Hynniew Trep Hynniew Skum ki long kiba riewspah ha ka liang ki kur ki jait. Kine ki jait ki khong ki wan da ka daw bad la pynskhem i'a ki da ka niam tynrai U Hynniew Trep. Ngi ngeit ba ki kur ki jait ki mih na ka lawbei tynrai kaba long ka kmie nyngkong jong kawei pa kawei ka kur ha ka jait bynriew Hynniew Trep. U shongkha ba nyngkong eh jong ka kur la khot kyrteng u Thawlang bad ia u longkhi nyngkong la ong u Suitnia. Ngi burom ia ka longkur ka longkha. bad la bynshet ia ka kamram ka longkmie, u longkni bad u longkpa ha ka rukom longi'ieng longsem jong ngi pateng la pateng. Ki kynthei Hynniew 1’rep ki ri ia ka jait ka khong ki kmie bad kni tymmen naduh nyngkong ka sngi. Ki dei ki longkmie ha ki khun ki kti bad ki longkha ha ki khun ki para shynrang ne hymmen shynrang jong ki. U Rangbah Hynniew Trep u long u longkhi ha ki pyrsa para ha iiengkur ha kaba ka spah ka phew bad ka synshar iieng ka synshar kur ka don hangta. Ki Hirna Khasi ki bat ia kane ka dustur nylla ha kaba u pyrsa shynrang u shimti ia ka synshar ..khadar ynda khyllait u kni. Ha iiengkhun u shynrang Hynniewtrep u long u longkpa ha kaba ka jingieid bad sumar sukher ka shong ha ki tyrpeng jong u. Ki kur ki jait u Hynniew Trep ki i'ai heh kur lyngba ki kynthei na ki jait, ki kpoh bad ki iieng. Bunsien ngi lap ba ka kur kaba heh jaid ka don bun tylli ki shnat kur ha ki jait ba iapher. Kane ka long na ka daw ka jingkynriah shnong ne iieng bad la tip noh ia ki da kawei pat ka kyrteng jait. Hynrei katba dang tip ia ka snam kur, kata ba iamih na kajuh ka'iawbei tynrai, ka mynsiem ieid kur ka syn- shar ha ki. Shikur ki long shidoh shisnam bad ka ’lei longkur long jait ka kdup ia ki. Rukom Shongkha Shongmau Shaphang ka shongkha shongman, u Hynniew Trep u bat kyntang faka. Umju shongkha shikur ne shipara kha.

Dang lap ha kine ki snem ba hadien b» kano kano ka jait bynriew kaba shongkha jan than haba dang don jing adei jan ha ka snam, kam juh lah neh slem. Ki khun ki kti jong ki, la ong, ki long anna ha ka met ka phad bad ki long kiba duna ba ka liang ka pyrkhat ka pyrdain. KI KUR KI JAIT 7 Ka rukom pyrkhat shaphang kaiawbei ne kmie kur ka long kaba la i'aw ne slem bad la buh jingmut bha shaphang jong ka da ki longdien. Ngi shem ba tang shu kha ia ki khyllung shynrang ki jer ki thoh da ki khnam iawbei, ryntieh iawbei bad la ki kynthei pat da ka wait ka khoh iawbei. Ki jer bad kyrteng ia ki khyllung ha ka jait jong ka kmie. Lada i khyllung i iam kyndit haba thiah khlem tip briew ei ei ki ju ong mai ka iawbei. Hynrei lada i rkhie haba ohthiah ki ju ong iaraifi kaiawbei. Wat ia ka longrynieng haduh u shhiuh ki bniat la ngeit ki dei ki jong kaiawbei. Ha kane ka rukom sa ioh kynnoh ki ’niat i awbei katba ym pat khein ki bniat nyngkong, bad ki ’niuh iawbei ha shynrong khlieh ki khyllung katba ym pat palat shi snem naduh ba kha. U shynrang Hynniew Trep um ju shim jait shalade. Dei ki kynthei kiba bat ia ka jait. Ha ki sngi ba kham hadien don bun bah ki shynrang Hynniew Trep kiba shongkha ha ki kynthei dkhar ai jait kpa, pynban kim shym pynbakla ia ka dustur kheiii kur khein kha. U kyntang 'iawbei ia ka bad ki khun jong u, ki ioh ia ki jait thymmai ha ka jait bynriew Hyniiiew Trep. Ka Jait Bynriew Kao Im Junom Ka la don ka jingud bad jingsngewbynniaw ha kine ki por ia ka jmgiakhleh khaw lang kaba jyllei ha ka shongkha shongman bad kiwei pat ki jait bynriew. La i'athuh Ipa ruh hana ba sa tang katta katta snem kane ka jait bynriew kan duh jait noh na sla pyrthei. U Tirot Singh, la lathuh ba shwa ba un lap u la kren khadduh ha U Mango Taso da kaba ong ba ynda “phi poi sha la ka ri, to lathuh la ki para ri jong nga ba U Tirot Singh u lap kum u Syiem.” Haba u Tirot Singh u ong 1a kitei ki ktien, la lathuh u phai artad ia la ki khmat sha ki Lum Khasi shwa ban lap.

Ki khun ki ksiew u Hynniew Trep ki sngew sarong ia la u Syiem uba lap ban im ki khun ka ri. Ka Hima Nongkhlaw ka la loh pat la ka jinglaitluid ba paka naduh ka IS tarik u Nailar 1947 bad u Shri Jairam Das Daulatram u la buh Maw Nongrim ia u Mot Tirot Singh ha Mairang ha ka IS tarik u Nohprah, 19S3. Dang donkam mynta ban buh tyngkai noh sa ia ka nongrim lieng ha kaba la kba, bad pynheh pynsan la u Tirot Singh ha 15. Ka Mei Rilum dated April 2. 1972 (Editorial) da u Babu Norman Singh Syiem. 100 KI KHUN KI KSIEW U HYNfilEW TREP Nongkhlaw. U Tirot Singh u dei kni la u Hain Singh 14 uba long Syiem ha ka Hima Nongkhlaw ha shwa jong u. Ka kmie U Tirot Singh ka 'dei Ka Ksan Syiemlieh bad u kpa jong u u dei u Kongor Khein Nongkynrih, uba la sumar bad kit khia la la u khun ha ka por ba ka jingim u khun (U Tirot Singh) ka don ha ka jingma. U Pa’iem Tirot Singh u la long uba shlur mynsiem bad um ju kylla jutaag wei u la khlei ia ka juban lak bad ieng haduh kaba kut na ka bynta ka ri. Kumba ju long ki longshwa manshwa, U Tirot Singh u la ai nuksa ha la ki pateng pakit, ba baba ka por ka dawa dei ban Ieng Rangbah na ka bynta ka ri bad ka jait bynriew. Ka kot khubor New India ha ka 7 tarik u Nailar (August) 1902, ka ong kumne shaphang ka jait bynriew jong ngi ha ka kyrteng “The Khasis”. “The first British knowledge of the Khasi Hills dates from the time when the East India Company acquired the Dewani of Bengal in 1765 ; which also included the adjoining district of Sylhet. But the hillmen had never acknowledged any subjection to the Mohammedans and consequently they remained absolutely independent of the British power till 1826, when Assam was conquered and European enterprise was soon attracted by the necessities of commerce arising from the monopoly of the lime quarries from which Bengal has drawn its supply from time immemorial. The Khasis had previously been known only as trouble- some marauders, particularly upon the plains of Sylhet, and their ravages between 1780 and 1790 are specially mentioned as severe ” Ka jingmut jong katei ka jingthoh ha ka ktien Khasi ka long kumne”, “Ki Phareng ki la bna shaphang ka Khasi Hills naduh ka por ba ka East India Company ka la ioh la ka Dewani of Bengal ha ka snem 1765 ; kaba la kyllum lang ruh la ka district ba marjan ka Sylhet. Kine ki riewlum kirn ju shah synshar mynno mynno ruh ha ki Mahommedan bad kumta ki long ki riew laitluid na ka jingsynshar ki British tad haduh ka snem 1826 haba ka Assam ka la shah jop, bad ki nongkhali Phareng (European) ki sngewdon kam ban wan khali 16. Barobor la tip la ki Kbasi mynsbwa kum ki nonghiarthma ba eb rang ha ki pyntha jong ka Sylhet, bad ka jingpyndik jong ki h|pdeng ki snem 1780 bad 1790 ki long kiba sbyrkbei sat kaba dang lakynmaw ” Ka jait bynriew jong ngi ka ju long kaba snar, kaba lohi jngai bad ka la pynmih kyrhai ki riewsblur, ki riewstad bad U Tirot Singh u la long uwei na kita. Ai ba ka Iyer, burom Tirot Singh, kaba la pyrsad myasiem biang naduh ka KHADSAN TAR1K U NOHPRAH 1953, kan iai rhem junom ha ki khun ka ri. Kiba kynmaw la kato ka sngi ha Mairang, kim lah klet i'a ki khan ki hajar, ki bakhraw batri bad ki kynrem ki lyndan na kylleng sawdong ba — sa shisien pat ki la kyntiew nam i'a la u Pa’iem ba ngi ieid eh. Ka Thma Hima Jaintia Bad Ki Phareng (1774) Ka thma Htma Jaintia bad ki Phareng ka la khie nyngkong eh ha ka snem 1774 A.D. Shu kyndit kyndit bad khlem daw ei ei ruh, ka 7th Battalion of Sepoy ryngkat ki 3 kompeni ki shipai na Sylhet hapoh ka jingialam u Cap. Elicker ka la wan tur ban pynjot ia ka shnong Rajagunge, kaba don kumba 9 kms. shwa ban poi sha Jaintiapur na Sylhet. Kane ka la jia ka ka 24 tarik u Lber 1774. Shi taiew shwa katei ka jingjia, ka Hima Jaintia ka la suba sniew ia ki briew ka East India Company, namar ka jinglum shipai lum swar ki Phareng ha ka shnong Sylhet naduh ka 17 tarik u Lber 1774. Ka Hima Jaintia ne Sutnga ka la sngew ma, bad kloi lan ka la tih ki kharai, ki ’liew lep bad ki kut i»l«h thma baroh shilynter ka hima khamtam ha ki thain Rajagunge. Ka jingloh jingtip ka Hima Jaintia ka la urlong shisha namar ka kynhun nong hiar thma ba la kieng atiar ka la wan poi top ha Rajagunge. Ka Hima Jaintia ka la i'aleh dohsnieh ban 'iada ia ka kut thma ha Rajagunge. Ka la sei lut ia ki ’riew i'aleh ban pyntur mar shiliang pyrshah ia ki Phareng. Haba ki sngew thuh ba kirn don jaka shuh, ki kynran noh da ka jingbym banse.

Ha ka liang ka mynsiem shlur bad ka jinglong doh satar ki Rangiapom ka Hima Jaintia, kim shym duna ei ei ruh na kino kino ki ’riew ialeh thma ha ka pyrthei. Hynrei namar ki nongshun ki don ki tiar thma ba kham khlain bad ki tup ki man kiba . beh, ki la ioh lad ban leh trai khlieh. U Capt. Elicker u Ia nahg tur ha ka lynti sha ka nongbah Jaintiapur. Ki Rangiapom ka Hima Jaintia wat la katta ruh kim shym ai jem. Ki la ialeh iap shisha ban iada ia la ka nongbah. Ka kynhun shipai shong hati jong ka hima ryngkat ki ryntieh ki khnam, bad ki tup rit ki la thef sha ki Phareng. Kane ka la jia ha ka 29 tarik u Lber 1774, bad ka jingialeh ka la long baroh shi sngi. U Capt. E, Elicker u la rung ha ka nongbah Jaintiapur ha ka 30 tarik u Lber 1774. SA KHYNDIAT HO 103 Ki jingjia shwa katei ka dun* Naduh ba ka Phareng ka la shoog skhem ba Bengal badien ka Dewani of Bengal ( 12 tarik u Nailar 1765 ) ka la bat lut la u saipan tyngka hangto hadien ka jingi'ohlong mahajon jong ka. Hynrei kam bun tang katta, bad ka la iohi khmat de la ka Hima Jaintia bariewspah (shabar ka Bengal) bad ka la thaw lad kumne : Ka la phah la u W.M. Thackeray ban long Saheb Bishar(Collector) ha Sylhet ha kabajan kut ka snem 1772 A. Tang shisnem tam hadien, u Richard Barwell uwei na ki rangbah ka East India Company u la thoh na Dacca sha u W.M. Thackeray ha ka 8 tarik u Rymphang 1774 kumne : “Da ka jing'iaiban eh jong phi ban loh u Rangbah Shipai u ban ialam la ki shipai kiba don ha Sylhet pyrshah ki Khasi (Cossyahs) nga la kyrpad la u Ensign Leake ban lalam la ki bad u la kohnguh da kaba sngewbha” (Sylhet District Record Vol. Ki daw jong ka thma ki long 17 ; — 1) Ka jingbym lah pynlaid kam bha u Thackeray na ka bynta ka jinglaitluid u Syiem Jaintia bad ka jingheh hima jong u ha dkhar, ryngkat bad ka jingkhot sngewbha ki dykhar ba un pynheh shuh shuh. 2) Ka jingkwah u Thackeray ban loh king lieng khlera jingpyn- wit bad khlem da siew ei ei ha ka wah Surma kaba dei hapoh u Syiem, namar dei nangne ba ka dieng bad u mawshun babha eh ki leit pyndap la ka Bengal. (Peit ki shithi u Barwell sha u Warren Hastings, 22 tarik u Lber 1774, bad sha u Thackeray 27 tarik u juh bnai. U Warren Hastings imat um kwah thma, hynrei u Thackeray bad u Barwell kim shah, ki ong ba dei ban da ai jingsneng la une uba heh na Id Syiem lada ngi kwah ban pyntieng la kiwei pat kiba rit. KI jingmlh na ka thma : — U Syiem Chattra Singh u la long u Syiem ka Hima Jaintia ha ka por jong katei ka thma, hynrei u la lap noh khyndiat bnai hadien jong ka thma. Kumta u Bijay Narayanan u la shimti la ka kam syiem hadien jong u. Dei ha ka por une u syiem uba shimti thymmai la ka kam syiem ba ka Hima Jaintia ka la hap siew haduh Rs. 15,000/- (Khadsan hajar tyngka) kum ka bai kliar wait sha ki Phareng. Ka Syngkhong Jingtip Vol. 4 dated ka snem 1939 sla 79. 104 KI KHUN KI KSIEW U HYNftlEW TREP 2) Ki Phareng ki la lob pyniaid lieng katba mon ha ka wah Surma khlem da siew dor ei-ei. 3) Nangta ka Hiraa Jaintia kan ym mushlia shuh ha kino kino ki kam ba ladei bad ka Company. 4) Ka Hima Jaintia ka iai sah hi kum ka hima laitluid naduh ka rithor Nowgong (Gobha) haduh rithor Surma (Jaintia Parganas) tad haduh ka por ynda la shit bha ka thma Nongkhlaw. U Sngap Singh U Syiem Sngap Singh ka Hima Maram u long uwei na ki Rangdajied ba pawnam ha ka ri. Une u Pa’iem u la long syiem ha ka por ba ki shipai ka East India Company ki wan hiar thma 1a kane ka ri ha ka snem 1829. Uwei u riewstad u ong lada phi bishar la uno uno u 18. U Syiem Sngap Singh, ngi shem u dei u briew uba stad, namar wat u la 'ialeh thma thiphew inem bad ki Phareng naduh ka snem 1829 haduh 1839, hynrei u kloi ban soi ia ka “Treaty” ban iasuk thma nob bad ki Phareng khlem da die 1a ka jinglaitluid ka Hima. Haba ka Hima Nongkhlaw, Hima Shyllong, Hima Rambrai bad kiwei de ki hima ha ka ri ki shah leh beih ha ki Phareng ha ka snem 1829 ter ter, U Syiem Sngap Singh u la sat ka mynsiem. Kloi lan, u la lum la ki briew ka Hima Maram bad latylli para Khasi ban ai jingsneng la ki nongthombor. Ka mynsiem ieid hima, ieid ri bad ieid jait bynriew ka dang paw tyngkrein ha une u Pa’iem. U la khyrwit la ki shipai Phareng haduh ba la suwan hi kbop. Ka thma Nongkhlaw 1829 — ka la wai noh ha ka snem 1833 — hynrei u Syiem Sngap Singh u am dukhi sa hynriew snem ei ei. U la ther la ki shipai ki swar ka sorkar Phareng ha ki thain Nongnah, 19 Mawtajem bad thiep Bamon haduh ba u Lister u bap ban lasuk da kaba lateh kular noh. Toi ka sorkar Phareng ka ju kiar ban lateh “Treaty’* bad kiba bun ki hima ha kane ka thain shatei lam mihngi jong ka ri India, la it sa tang ha bym bsnse eh. U Syiem Sngap Singh u bat ia ka hok, u pyn'ieng ia ka nia bad da ka jutang ieid ri u la rah ia ka Hima Maram bad ka jait bynriew Hynniew Trap sha ka kyrdan ban ia ryngkat tyrpeng bad ka Hima bah ka pyrthei (Hima Bilat) ha ka juk ba la leit noh.
